Subject: Brown-bag: Hands-on console lab — request to swap to engineering-only slot

Hi Sara,

Thanks again for signing up for the hands-on console walkthrough next Thursday (Jul 8) at 11:00 AM PT. Quick note — we had a last-minute ask from your PM team to open an engineering-only deep-dive in the earlier 9:00 AM PT slot the same day.

Would your broader group be open to moving to the 1:30 PM PT slot that day so the engineers can take 9:00? We can also split the session into a 45-minute engineering lab (9:00–9:45) and a 45-minute product/demo slot (13:30–14:15) if that helps.

Attached is a short prep checklist we usually share — it covers service-account access, a sample API key rotation, and a tiny test dataset. If you confirm the swap I’ll send updated invites and an engineering-only ICS for your team.

Agenda (proposed):
- 9:00–9:45 — Engineering deep-dive: token billing, deployment pinning, console runtime traces (engineers only)
- 13:30–14:15 — Product walkthrough: Console UX, rollout controls, cost/latency dashboard

Can you confirm attendee lists for each block and whether your infra team needs VPC access during the lab?

Best,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.inference.com
(415) 555-0123

Thanks, Aditya — appreciate the heads-up.

We can do the split. Confirming:
- Engineering block (9:00–9:45): Jon Becker (lead infra), Priya Shah (SRE), Marco Liu (backend)
- Product block (13:30–14:15): Sara Lopez (product), Elena Ruiz (payments), Amos King (compliance)

A couple of asks from our side:
- Can the engineering block include a short demo of the KV cache behavior with a >8k token prompt?
- Our security team needs to verify service-account scopes beforehand — I’ll send the contact shortly.

We’ll accept the lab-prep checklist and Jon will coordinate the VPC access request if needed. Please go ahead and send the updated invites.
